name: Cericlamine
summary: Cericlamine (INN; developmental code JO-1017) is a potent and moderately selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) of the amphetamine family that was investigated as an antidepressant for the treatment of depression, anxiety disorders, and anorexia nervosa by Jouveinal but did not complete development and was never marketed. It reached phase III clinical trials in 1996 before development was discontinued in 1999.

pharmacology.text: Cericlamine (INN; developmental code JO-1017) is a potent and moderately selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) of the amphetamine family (specifically, a derivative of phentermine, and closely related to chlorphentermine, a highly selective serotonin releasing agent) that was investigated as an antidepressant for the treatment of depression, anxiety disorders, and anorexia nervosa by Jouveinal but did not complete development and was never marketed.

uses.text: Cericlamine (INN; developmental code JO-1017) is a potent and moderately selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) of the amphetamine family (specifically, a derivative of phentermine, and closely related to chlorphentermine, a highly selective serotonin releasing agent) that was investigated as an antidepressant for the treatment of depression, anxiety disorders, and anorexia nervosa by Jouveinal but did not complete development and was never marketed.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the SSRIs, can cause nausea, sleep problems and sexual problems, and at high levels can cause serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。同類的 SSRI 藥物可能造成噁心、睡眠問題與性功能問題，濃度過高時可能引發血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。同类的 SSRI 药物可能造成恶心、睡眠问题与性功能问题，浓度过高时可能引发血清素症候群。

fact.en: It is built on the frame of phentermine, a member of the amphetamine family, yet instead of releasing stimulating chemicals it mainly blocks the reuptake of serotonin, like SSRI antidepressants do.
fact.zh: 它建立在安非他命家族成員芬特明的骨架上，但它不是促使興奮性物質釋放，而是像 SSRI 抗憂鬱藥一樣，主要阻斷血清素的回收。
fact.zhHans: 它创建在安非他命家族成员芬特明的骨架上，但它不是促使兴奋性物质释放，而是像 SSRI 抗忧郁药一样，主要阻断血清素的回收。
